To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Sedentary behavior is highly prevalent among adolescents, and smartphone use is associated with high amount of sedentary behavior”.
The prevalence of sedentary behavior was 47.5%; the situations most associated with sedentaries behavior were: smartphone (6.23), video game (2.50), obligations (2.43) and television (2.35).
